name: Waikiki Beachcomber by Outrigger
insider_take: Right in the heart of Waikiki's action, this vibrant beachside retreat puts you steps from legendary surf breaks and world-class shopping.
whats_special: The Waikiki Beachcomber sits on the famous Kalakaua Avenue, directly across from the Royal Hawaiian Center and just two blocks from Waikiki Beach. The hotel is home to the Blue Note Hawaii, the only West Coast location of the iconic New York jazz club, featuring world-renowned musicians in an intimate setting. The rooftop pool deck offers stunning views of Diamond Head crater, a 300,000-year-old volcanic landmark.
pro_tip: Book a corner room on higher floors for panoramic ocean and Diamond Head views, and time your arrival for the nightly torch lighting ceremony at nearby Kuhio Beach Park at sunset.
dont_miss: The hotel's central location makes it perfect for exploring the International Market Place across the street, catching live performances at Blue Note Hawaii, and accessing the famous Waikiki Beach where Duke Kahanamoku first popularized surfing. The nearby Honolulu Zoo and Kapiolani Park are just a 10-minute walk away.
pros: Prime Waikiki Beach location with direct beach access
Walking distance to Royal Hawaiian Center and luxury shopping
Modern Hawaiian-inspired rooms with ocean and city views
Multiple dining options including rooftop restaurant and tiki bar
cons: High-traffic tourist area with busy surroundings
Premium pricing due to prime beachfront location
